$comment: A known-negative: this rule uses a camelCase id, which canonical identity forbids. Loading it must throw rather than silently skipping it, because a catalog that loads partially shrinks the denominator every score is computed over.

rules.title: Camel case is not canonical identity
rules.description: Present only to prove the loader rejects it.
rules.rationale: Two spellings of one rule is the drift canonical identity abolishes.
